natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for the ERC-20 Capped extension — seeds the supply cap and registers IERC20Capped via ERC-165. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} (through {MultiInit}) inside the initializing window opened by the diamond, alongside the base {ERC20Init}; it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer. Reverts with {IERC20Capped-ERC20InvalidCap} when `cap_` is zero.
